text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh

Raya KL-Kuala Selangor) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 Jun 2011.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya KL-Kuala Selangor yang

bermula dari kilometer 0.00 (di koordinat U 15220.998, T-36487.575 Grid Cassini

Negeri Selangor) dan berakhir di kilometer 30.70 Lebuh Raya KL-Kuala Selangor (di

koordinat U 13601.51, T-10067.94 Grid Cassini Negeri Selangor) termasuklah

Persimpangan Bertingkat Ijok, Plaza Tol Ijok, Persimpangan Bertingkat Puncak Alam,

Plaza Tol Kuang Barat, Jalan Susur Kundang, Plaza Tol Kuang Timur, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Kuang, Plaza Tol Taman Rimba Templer dan Persimpangan Bertingkat

Taman Rimba Templer dan jalan-jalan sambungannya, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 30.70

kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

DATO' SHAZIMAN BIN ABU MANSOR

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat di bawah seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (KL-KUALA SELANGOR EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the state Government of Selangor, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (KL-Kuala Selangor

Expressway) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 23 June 2011.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the KL-Kuala Selangor Expressway

commencing from kilometre 0.00 (at coordinates N 15220.998, E-36487.575 of the

Selangor State Cassini Grid) and ending at kilometre 30.70 KL-Kuala Selangor

Expressway (at coordinates N 13601.51, E-10067.94, of the Selangor State Cassini Grid)

including Ijok Interchange; Ijok Toll Plaza, Puncak Alam Interchange, Kuang Barat Toll

Plaza, Kundang Slip Road, Kuang Timur Toll Plaza, Kuang Interchange, Taman Rimba

Templer Toll Plaza and Taman Rimba Templer Interchange and its link roads, being a

distance of 30.70 kilometres, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
